automationNotes: Steps mirror the document exactly — https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/security/change-personal-details. Covers: Profile icon → Profile dropdown → Profile section → Profile Image, First Name, Last Name, Company Name fields → Email (read-only) → Save. Env vars CS_FIRST_NAME, CS_LAST_NAME, CS_COMPANY_NAME should match current account values to avoid unintended data changes. Any step that fails means the app does not match the documentation; the documentation must be updated.
